interpretation: Both JVMD and JDTLS pass independent reference addition with an immediate target request and settled confirmation in one attempt.

JDTLS modern supertype and legacy parent-change transitions block the initial expansion because fresh-item preparation is stale. They settle on attempts 17 and 3, respectively, while retaining incorrect outcomes.
Original acquisition and expansion identities, times and started/finished attempt journals validate without integrity issues or source drift. No immediate expansion is fabricated.
The modern JDTLS supertype case additionally retains nonzero shutdown without a harness kill. JVMD declares both hierarchy routes unsupported.
All original bundle hashes and inventory membership verify at packaging. This is one diagnostic block, not comparative performance evidence.
